note: Capability claim DAG (C01, issue #45; plan section 7). Nodes are stamped ONLY by checks registered in src/gf180_dx7/capabilities.py CHECKS; evidence lives in evidence/capabilities/<node>.json and is produced exclusively by tools/compile_capabilities.py --stamp. Declared-but-unregistered nodes (engine 'planned: ...') can never pass. This file is data for the compiler; never hand-edit the generated views (docs/CAPABILITIES.md, docs/capabilities.json, README block).
